newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Unocal unit workers end strike.
newsitem.headline: Unocal unit workers end strike.

text.p: Striking workers of Philippine Geothermal Inc (PGI), a subsidiary of Unocal Corp, have ended their strike, a union official said on Monday.

"After 21 days of strike, acting secretary of labour Buenaventura Magsalin assumed jurisdiction over the labour dispute ... and resolved the main issues to the satisfaction of labour as well as management," Jesus Consulta, acting union president of PGI Employees Union, said in a statement.
He said the strike ended on Sunday after PGI agreed to reinstate 168 dismissed employees as well as stop any further layoffs.
PGI was in the midst of corporate downsizing when its workers staged a strike in its 426-megawatt Makban geothermal plant and 330-megawatt Tiwi plant.
The two power plants supply 17 percent of the power requirements of the main island of Luzon.
